title: Monotone Blue
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At an all-boys high school of anthropomorphic animals, bored cat Hachi sees the world in muted colors until Aoi, a quiet, high-achieving lizard, transfers in. Hachi is drawn to the bright blue tail Aoi keeps hidden because of past events, and the two boys slowly open up to each other (Seven Seas blurb via AniList; Women Write About Comics review). One volume.
life_message: Being different is not shameful; differences can be what draw people together.

content.note: Bullying of Aoi (AniList Bullying spoiler; MU Bullied Male Lead).
